techniques: single monolithic always block split into six always blocks (sampler, prescaler, bit counter, data shifter, outputs/flags)
nested if/else-if conditions flattened into named decode wires (tk_live, ph_live, hdr, mid, tail, step, park, fin_ok, fin_bad)
valid set/clear priority rewritten as Boolean equation vq <= fin_ok | (vq & ~tready)
arithmetic rewrites: x-1 as x + 19'h7FFFF, shifts as concatenations {prescale,3'b000}
if-else replaced by ternaries (ph decrement/clear, latch hold)
equiv: PASS BMC depth 12 (full) from reset [-set-at 1 in_rst 0]
